description: Figure 7, specifically the right plot, illustrates the CoLeG-R metric across various model scales within the LLaMA-2 family, with the x-axis representing the model scales—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—arranged from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", is scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart contains four grouped bars for each model scale, distinguished by color and pattern: a solid blue bar for "no SFT", a solid orange bar for "+ SFT on D₀", a solid purple bar for "+ SFT on D₀, D₁", and a solid red bar for "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂". For each model scale, the bars are arranged in ascending order of SFT dataset size, with the "no SFT" bar being the shortest and the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bar being the tallest. The bar heights correspond to the following approximate CoLeG-R values: for LLaMA-2-7B, the values are approximately 65% (no SFT), 70% (+ SFT on D₀), 75% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂); for LLaMA-2-13B, the values are approximately 70% (no SFT), 75% (+ SFT on D₀), 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂); for LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately 75% (no SFT), 80% (+ SFT on D₀), 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in a consistent order across all model scales. There are no visual emphasis or annotations on any specific bars.
